content.short: Stryke is a decentralized options exchange for trading crypto options with on-chain liquidity and transparent execution.
content.description: Stryke is a decentralized derivatives protocol focused on on-chain options trading. The platform supports crypto options for assets such as BTC, ETH, ARB, and other markets, with products designed for both retail and professional traders. Stryke emphasizes intraday options, cross-chain options infrastructure, and liquidity that can integrate with existing LP positions from DEXs such as Uniswap and PancakeSwap. Trading activity is transparent and on-chain, letting users retain control over funds while accessing options strategies, premiums, and capital-efficient derivatives liquidity.
